description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database viewer interface. It contains structure and styling for browsing databases, tables, and viewing data, including JavaScript code for dynamic content loading and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database entry to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates an HTML table from data and inserts it into container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates the HTML for a cell, handling objects, nulls, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data.
